note: Approval stamps: qid -> stamp. An auto-approve stamp (build spec rule 1.9) carries stamp, by, at, checksum (sha256 of the sidecar file), svg (sha256 of the rendered picture at 390 and 1280 px), files (sha256 of every renderer source it draws with), guard and review. A later change to any of them voids the stamp and the item returns to draft (build.mjs, render-check.mjs, stamp-gate.mjs, deploy-clean.sh). Thomas's own approvals use by, at, checksum and guard.
